correctness.rationale: Exact distances in kth path powers give unique geodesics on fixed residues, so every MV class has <=2k vertices. The proof handles graph-completeness boundary; for n>2k the all-positive-parameter two-block construction supplies shortest monotone paths avoiding all same-class internal vertices, explicitly treating t=2 beta<alpha. Restriction preserves witness geodesics. BFS and exhaustive exact-cover checks agree on 520 constructions and 40 small cases.
